revision_reason: After revision 1 passed development but before any sealed result was opened, float32 matrix runs became operationally disproportionate under 16-GB unified-memory compression (up to 76 seconds per optimizer step). A pinned one-step fp16 smoke completed in 7.99 seconds with finite loss and gradients. Revision 2 changes only MPS compute dtype, reruns the development gate from the base checkpoint, and never mixes revision-1 adapters with revision-2 outcomes.
